subject: Invoice authorship and delivery preference — portal primary, email copies
messages:
From: Elaine Park <finance@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice creation & delivery for pilot (PO 8421 attached)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo — Acme procurement asked us to confirm how invoices will be created and delivered for the pilot tied to PO 8421 (attached). A couple quick questions:

- Who will be the invoice originator on the document (Redwood or Acme partner)?
- We prefer receiving invoices via a portal, but we need a PDF copy emailed to finance@acme-corp.com for our AP intake. Is that feasible?
- VAT breakdown: line-level VAT is required on our side (we need VAT registration shown on header).
- Do you support an XML/UBL payload or only PDF?

Appreciate a short note on the recommended setup and whether you can run the first month as a vendor-emitted invoice.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Finance — Acme Health
finance@acme-corp.com
Attachment: Acme_PO_8421.pdf (pdf, 180 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <finance@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery for pilot (PO 8421 attached)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a proposed default we can implement immediately:

- Invoice originator: Redwood can emit the invoice (we typically do this for hosted customers).
- Delivery: we recommend portal as the canonical delivery (better for automated matching) and we will send a PDF email copy to finance@acme-corp.com on invoice issuance.
- VAT: we will include VAT registration and a line-level VAT breakdown in the template you receive.
- Payloads: portal supports both PDF and an XML/UBL export; we can provide a sample XML mapping for your AP system.

Proposed default (unless you prefer otherwise): Redwood emits invoices; portal primary; email copy to finance@acme-corp.com; month-end consolidated statement available on request. If that works, I’ll loop in Kimberly to capture technical mapping and provide sample files.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elaine Park <finance@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Andrew Miles <andrew.miles@procurely.io>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery for pilot (PO 8421 attached)

Marissa — this looks fine in principle. A few follow ups from procurement / AP: 

- Confirm that the PDF emailed to finance@acme-corp.com will contain the same invoice ID and amounts as the portal record (we need 1:1 matching).
- We would like the option to receive a machine-readable XML (UBL) on issuance — our AP system will ingest that. Can you provide an example payload and field mapping?
- For tax reporting: please ensure the invoice header includes Redwood’s VAT number and the line items show tax amount and tax rate per line.

If you can provide the XML sample and a short note on how the portal sends email copies (immediate vs batched), we can sign off and begin onboarding.

Thanks,
Elaine

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <finance@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery for pilot (PO 8421 attached) — recommended setup

Hi Elaine / Marissa,

Following Marissa’s note, recommended configuration for smooth AP onboarding: 

1) Redwood as invoice originator (Redwood’s name + VAT on header).
2) Portal primary for canonical record; immediate email push (within 2 minutes of issuance) to finance@acme-corp.com and monitoring webhook to your SFTP/XML ingestion if you prefer automated pickup.
3) Include invoice_number, invoice_date, line_items with unit_price, qty, tax_rate, tax_amount, currency, PO number, and buyer VAT id in XML. We’ll provide an example mapping and a small test payload.
4) Monthly consolidated remittance statement available as a CSV export from portal on the 1st of the month.

Next steps: I can drop the XML sample and a DocuSign link for the AP terms. If Acme confirms, we’ll spin up a portal-side test tenant and run a quick 30-minute mapping call with Andrew from Procurely (cc’d).

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachment: onboarding_docusign_link.txt (link)

From: Elaine Park <finance@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Miles <andrew.miles@procurely.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 18:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery for pilot (PO 8421 attached) — confirmed

Thanks, Kim and Marissa — that configuration is acceptable to Acme. Confirming the decision: 

- Redwood will be the invoice issuer for the pilot (please ensure Redwood VAT# shows in the header).
- Portal will be the canonical delivery channel; an immediate PDF copy must be emailed to finance@acme-corp.com on issuance.
- Provide an XML/UBL sample and field mapping (we’d like to start the SFTP ingestion test next week).
- Please include the PO number on each invoice and ensure 1:1 invoice ID parity between portal and PDF.

Marissa/Kim: can you send the XML sample and a short onboarding playbook (SFTP credentials process + test window) by Friday? Andrew, can you confirm availability for a 30-minute mapping call next week?

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Director, Finance — Acme Health
finance@acme-corp.com
